error.cert_failed: TrueNAS's certificate couldn't be verified. TrueNAS uses a self-signed certificate unless you installed your own: install a certificate Home Assistant trusts (and use the name on it as the host), or turn off "Verify SSL certificate" to connect anyway. With it off, the connection is still encrypted, but a device on your network could pose as TrueNAS and capture the API key.
